# Deepriton

**Deepriton** is a liquide (pompage continu) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/fr/formats/ore-fields/).

## Extraction

| Property | Valeur |
|---|---|
| Quantité / extraction | 450 |
| Type d'extraction | liquide (pompage continu) |
| Effet d'activation | non requis |
| Document de géo-scan | definition 8699 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
